Gaza City, Gaza A young girl sits with a water carrier outside tents set up near destroyed homes in the Zeitoun neighbourhood.
People on Cullercoats beach, North Tyneside, at sunrise.
Purulia, India Women pray during the Karam Puja harvest festival, dedicated to the Karam tree.
Anguiano, Spain A person on stilts takes part in the festival of the Anguiano Dancers. The dancers walk down a slope on stilts to worship the town’s patron, Mary Magdalene.

Portadown, Northern Ireland People gather at the Garvaghy Road, a Catholic enclave in the largely Protestant town of Portadown, on the day members of the Protestant Orange Order are expected to march through the area as they take part in the annual Drumcree parade.
Bangkok, Thailand A child is transported through a flooded area during heavy rain.
Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine A local resident shows drone debris at the scene of a Russian attack on a residential area.

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Activists display a giant inflatable of the president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, in the Vidigal favela ahead of Brazil’s general elections.
Taupō, New Zealand A prize-winning guinea pig is draped with a winner’s ribbon during the New Zealand national guinea pig show.
Hartford, US Olivia Rodrigo performs during the Unraveled Tour at People’s Bank Arena in Connecticut.

Velzen-Noord, the Netherlands Visitors take a bus ride at Tata Steel during the national Neighbors’ Day. Local residents and other interested parties received information about the steel producer’s working methods during the open day.
Glastonbury, UK The full harvest moon is obscured by clouds as it rises in the evening sky from behind St Michael’s Tower on Glastonbury Tor.
Young residents with bicycles watch smoke rise from a warehouse hit by a Russian drone strike in Kyiv.

Gaza Palestinian children walk to school past the rubble of a destroyed building as the academic year begins in Bureij. Benjamin Netanyahu delivered an inflammatory address to the United Nations on Thursday, decrying what he said was a global anti-Jewish conspiracy and swatting aside criticism of Israel’s war in Gaza, as he faces down international isolation and a fight for political survival in upcoming elections in Israel.

New York City, US Benjamin Netanyahu is seen on a television screen speaking during the UN general assembly in New York City. As planned protests erupted on the streets of the city, Netanyahu took aim at critics of the humanitarian crisis in Gaza , the international media, regional leaders such as Turkey’s Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, the leftwing commentator Hasan Piker and the New York City mayor, Zohran Mamdani, in an address that doubled as a stump speech to ignite his rightwing base for the elections.

US Air Force One with Donald Trump onboard flies over a river en route to JFK airport in New York for the UN general assembly. On the first day of the general assembly, Trump denied that the US was running short of critical munitions (‘we have more munitions than we could ever possibly even think of using’), attacked the international criminal court as a ‘rogue organisation’ and claimed once again that he was close to settling the war in Ukraine.

Washington DC, US President Donald Trump, first lady Melania Trump and the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, react after watching a military demonstration at the White House in Washington. At the start of his summit meeting with Trump , the Chinese president called for extensive cooperation with Washington to avoid the ‘Thucydides trap ’ that could put the US and China on a military collision course amid rising tensions over artificial intelligence, trade and Taiwan.

Tehran, Iran Iranian military forces conduct street parades in Tehran. Iran’s seven-day timetable to reopen the strait of Hormuz and start talks on its nuclear programme has been pitched as a deal that could rapidly extricate Donald Trump from a political crisis but requires the US president to make difficult concessions.

Kotelniki, Russia A woman looks at a damaged multi-storey residential building hit by what authorities described as a Ukrainian drone strike in Kotelniki . Kyiv has stepped up its campaign of long-range drone strikes against Russia in recent months, particularly against energy infrastructure, a vital source of the Kremlin’s revenue to fund its war effort.

Kyiv, Ukraine Firefighters work to extinguish a fire at an office building in Kyiv’s Solomianskyi district following a strike by a Russian Geran-5 jet-powered attack drone. Just as Ukraine has developed its drone and missile capability to almost match Russia’s – after its cities were subject at times to hundreds of drone strikes a day – Moscow has transformed its drone arsenal with a jet-powered revolution .

Kramatorsk, Ukraine A priest and a resident walk at the site of a damaged Orthodox church after a Russian airstrike in Kramatorsk. Russia could launch a limited military attack against a Nato country in the coming months, Danish intelligence said this week, in one of the starkest warnings yet by western security services.
Mediterranean Sea Sudan, a 24-year-old migrant from South Sudan , looks out to sea as the SOS Mediterranee rescue vessel sails toward Marina di Carrara in Italy.

Neufchâtel-Hardelot, France Migrants try to board a smuggler’s boat off the beach of Hardelot. The body of a man was found on the beach at Neufchâtel-Hardelot shortly after an attempted departure for England.

Madrid, Spain Members of the Madrid tenants’ union form a barricade in front of the building where 87-year-old Maricarmen was to be evicted. Police fired rounds of teargas and made repeated baton charges as they tried to open a path for a judicial committee to carry out the eviction order, which was eventually executed.
Xinzo de Limia, Spain Firefighters attempt to extinguish a forest fire near the hamlet of Baltar.

Banjar, Indonesia Firefighters extinguish forest and land fires in Banjar. For months, parts of Indonesia’s Borneo and Sumatra islands have been ablaze . The fires are sometimes lit illegally as a cheap way to clear land for plantations of oil palm, of which Indonesia is the world’s largest producer.

Trishuli, Nepal People look at a house, damaged during August’s floods at Trishuli. Nepal’s prime minister, Balendra Shah, scolded world leaders at the UN this week , saying last month’s catastrophic deadly flood was a reminder that climate change keeps hurting people who didn’t cause the crisis.
Sakura, Japan A car is partially submerged in floodwaters after Typhoon Dujuan brought torrential rain to Sakura.
Tiburon, California, US A prescribed fire practitioner uses a drip torch to ignite a burn at Angel Island state park near Tiburon.
Vilnius, Lithuania People participate in fire rituals during the autumn equinox festival in Vilnius.
London, England Fans watch the football match between Millwall and West Ham while standing on Lime bikes outside of the Den stadium in London.
Nagoya, Japan Carlos Edriel Yulo of the Philippines competes on the vault during the artistic gymnastics men’s qualification at the Asian Games in Nagoya.
